entities.name: Jean Alexander Heinrich Clapier de Colongue

entities.summary: Jean Alexander Heinrich Clapier de Colongue was a Baltic German marine engineer and founder of a theory of magnetic deviation for magnetic compasses, living and working in Imperial Russia.
